dossier.case_against: The need is not proven: I could not open the Indeed posts (login wall), and even as described they are generic job-description lines, not evidence that Excel or phone calls cause errors. No decision-maker route beyond generic info@ and phones; no WhatsApp link published. Pay signal is thin and self-claimed. By the grade rule, an inferred need with a weak pay signal and only business-level reach is a C. It could move to B if a human opens the Indeed posts while logged in and sees dispatch or stock handled outside any system, and to A only if a named operations head and a real pay signal are also found.

Offer a short look at a lightweight order-to-dispatch tracker with WhatsApp status updates, positioned as an add-on to whatever they already run. Before any outreach, a human should read the Indeed posts to confirm the wording and avoid quoting them wrongly.
